target: a few tens per nucleus, compact speckles
notes: Detected foci appear as compact, discrete speckles distributed throughout the nucleoplasm, consistent with canonical SC35/SRSF2 nuclear speckle morphology. The median 3D count of ~36.5 (IQR 34–40) aligns well with the expected 'few tens per nucleus'; the per-slice visible counts in the montage (~10–15 colored outlines per nucleus) are reasonable for a mid-z section sampling a fraction of the full 3D complement. No obvious over-splitting of large speckles into fragments, no gross under-detection of bright bodies, and the calls do not fill the nucleus indiscriminately.
